bio.text: Karines Reyes represents District 87 in the Bronx in the New York State Assembly.
According to her official biography, she was born in Santo Domingo in the Dominican Republic, grew up in Puerto Rico and Queens, and has lived in the Bronx for nearly 20 years.

The biography says she studied communications at CUNY Baruch College, earned a nursing degree by 2013, works as a registered nurse in the oncology department at Montefiore Einstein Hospital, and served on the New York State Nurses Association executive committee at Einstein Hospital.
